splitdistance.config.title: Split Distance
splitdistance.option.renderChunks.toolti: How many chunks actually get drawn. Leave your normal render distance high (32) so the server keeps sending far chunks for map mods to index. Off disables the mod.
splitdistance.option.threadGuard.tooltip: Report the full, uncapped distance to callers outside the render thread, so map mods that check render distance still scan the whole radius. Turn off if a map mod misbehaves.
